description: Verifies the conservative post-Newtonian dynamics: energy and orbital angular momentum conservation of an equal-mass 1PN binary integrated with the fourth-order Runge-Kutta scheme, and energy conservation of a Newtonian binary integrated with the symplectic Forest-Ruth scheme.

checks.label: the initial total energy is finite
the relative energy drift over 2000 steps stays below 1e-4
the relative drift of the orbital angular momentum stays below 1e-4

checks.section: Newtonian binary with the symplectic integrator
checks.label: the relative energy drift of the symplectic scheme stays below 1e-5

measurements.section: Newtonian binary with the symplectic integrator
measurements.name: relative_energy_drift_newtonian_symplectic
